messages:
jia: quick idea — prototyping a 'token lineage exposure' panel for the cost dashboard. shows how cache savings flow back to routes/models and who actually benefits. @ben?
ben: sounds useful. customers ask why their bills move when we change batching/routing. need a clear metric. :thinking_face:
jia: proposal: compute per-request attribution: gross_token_cost - cache_token_credit = net_token_cost, then aggregate by route+model with a decay window (7d). show both raw and rolling averages.
omar: watch out: continuous batching collapses origins. attribution will be wrong unless we keep origin_id in the batch metadata. currently proxy drops it. :(
jia: agreed — I'll add origin_id header and propagate into the batch record. small infra change.
lucy: UX ask — if cache_credit > gross_cost (negative net), how should we display? call it "net zero" or show negative rows? users might misinterpret negative spend.
ben: prefer clamp to zero with a tooltip that shows the breakdown. also surface median and 95p cost-per-1k-tokens for each model so teams can compare unit economics.
jia: here's a quick SQL of the rollup we plan to run for the 7d window:
```sql
SELECT route, model,
  SUM(tokens) AS total_tokens,
  SUM(gross_cost) AS gross_cost,
  SUM(cache_saved_tokens) AS cache_saved_tokens,
  SUM(gross_cost) - token_price_per_token * SUM(cache_saved_tokens) AS net_cost
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route, model;
```
omar: two practical concerns: (1) token_price_per_token differs by model/version and needs join to model_skus, (2) large tenants will skew sums — prefer median/percentile and sample weights.
jia: good call. we'll join model_skus and compute both sum and p50/p95. for heavy tenants we'll expose "top N contributors" and an adjustable sample rate.
lucy: telemetry needs: emit token_event(route, model, tokens, cache_saved_tokens, batch_id, origin_id). small schema bump but it's explicit.
deploy-bot: note: schema change queued — migration job required, rolling deploy recommended.
omar: timeline? will the migration lock tables?
jia: migration is append-only column, no lock expected. canary this week, full rollout after SRE signoff.
lucy: i'll mock the UI: heatmap by route vs model, toggle for 'show rolling avg', and a 'simulated-rollout' mode to preview how a new routing policy would change exposure. will post figma link.
ben: also add a "why my bill changed" explainer in console linking to the breakdown and the batch/origin trace. reduces support tickets.
jia: ok i'll PR the telemetry and SQL, lucy drop mocks, omar coordinate migration window. sync tomorrow 10:00. (reaction :thumbsup:)
